title.narrative: for support of the Feminist Dream Space

description.narrative: Urgent Action Fund for Feminist Activism (UAF) is a rapid response grantmaker supporting feminist activists working to keep each other and their communities safe while building lasting, resilient movements for justice, equity, and liberation. UAF provides fast, flexible support to women, trans, and nonbinary activists so they can respond to unexpected risks and opportunities, protect and care for themselves and one another, and nurture feminist movements that are creating a more just and equitable world. UAF houses the Feminist Dream Space, which aims at creating a community for collective reflection, learning, and strategizing about resources, philanthropic architecture, politics, and narratives of funding. This grant will allow UAF and its partners to strengthen a cross-regional, intersectional feminist movement within and beyond the philanthropic space. (Gender Equity and Governance)
